findingClass: A COMPLETED offer document that delivered far fewer fields than its document type gives (NSE RHP: 4 DOC-first receipts of the cover and business fields it prints).
failThreshold: For every COMPLETED offer document (DRHP, RHP, PROSPECTUS): FAIL when document_field_receipts rows for it fall below the expected count for its type. Reported per document by IPO slug, document id and type with delivered and expected counts - never a bare count (signal-ownership.md R1).
unverifiableWhen: The staging database or the document_field_receipts rows cannot be read, or the document file was purged (OD-32).
